args.title: Juniper Labware: Retail Returns Logistics – Summary
args.body:
- Apparel return rates have climbed to 24%, making returns a major cost center for retailers.
- Consolidating returns processing into dedicated hubs cut handling costs by roughly 20%.
- Companion piece finding: reselling returned items within 10 days preserves most of their original margin, underscoring the value of speed in the returns pipeline.
